top.title: Dubai introduces digital Nol QR tickets for metro, buses and trams
top.teaser: Public transport passengers in Dubai can now use digital QR codes on their phones to access the metro, trams and buses, eliminating the need for a single-use red paper Nol ticket. Passengers can buy digital Nol QR tickets through the Nol Pay or S'hail apps, the Roads and Transport Authority announced. top.impact_reason: Enhances neighborhood accessibility and public transit convenience.
top.headline: Dubai launches digital Nol QR tickets for public transport
top.summary: Commuters can now buy and use digital QR codes for metro, bus, and tram rides via apps. This update replaces traditional single-use paper tickets with mobile access.
top.why: Improved public transit connectivity adds value to nearby residential and commercial real estate.

top.headline: Dubai rental disputes settled in six days on average
